instruction: Fix `filter_records` so it keeps records whose key equals the given value (the comparison operator is currently inverted).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore.py b/datastore.py
--- a/datastore.py
+++ b/datastore.py
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@
 
 def filter_records(records, key, value):
     """Return records whose ``key`` equals ``value``."""
-    return [r for r in records if r.get(key) != value]
+    return [r for r in records if r.get(key) == value]
